name: Browser Use
description: Inspect and operate websites directly in the owner’s connected browser, including tabs, forms, collections, and authenticated file downloads. Prefer this toolkit for browser tasks.
progressive_guidance: Use direct browser inspection for website tasks in the owner's configured browser and relevant existing tab. Browser Use handles uploads, downloads and JavaScript dialogs without native pickers. Use computer_use only for browser chrome or genuine OS controls the browser helpers cannot handle, then return here. If browser access requires permission/setup, pause for the owner; never switch browsers or use Cua to bypass it. Establish collection scope and source identities through pagination or scrolling before processing; a DOM snapshot may be incomplete. Track verified progress and remaining work in the shared plan.
